hypothesis: Observed candidate actions improve future normalized-state prediction beyond history-only prediction at matched optimization budget

source.excluded_reason: historical trained/inspected pair or rejected earlier diagnostic candidate; never reuse as fresh holdout
source.episode_metadata_scope: ids,lengths,global row intervals,source shard ids,video shard ids and timestamps; never action/state/image/reward statistics for selection
source.candidate_inventory_policy: Require task identity for every episode in the pinned metadata inventory before assigning any split; incomplete cached shard coverage yields no provisional selections
source.ranking: ascending sha256(ASCII revision + '/' + decimal native_task_id + '/' + decimal episode_index + '/native-action-study-v1'); episode_index breaks ties
source.selection: first12 eligible episodes in hash order, fixed before action/image inspection; first8 train and next4 validation; no replacement after duplicate/provenance failure
source.row_budget_policy: reject whole plan if exceeded; do not truncate episodes, change hash order or select shorter replacements

source_acceptance_required_before_featur.same_partition_duplicate_groups: record groups and draw each verified group with equal probability; concrete grouped sampler must be frozen after source audit, before optimization
source_acceptance_required_before_featur.failure_policy: stop and preserve selected IDs; do not replace failed/duplicate trajectories after viewing payloads

features.normalization: fit raw state/action statistics on selected train episodes only; exclude actions with no successor; freeze once and share across arms/seeds

arms.observed_action: existing native six inputs, candidate_actions unchanged after shared train normalization
arms.normalized_zero_action: replace all7 normalized candidate action coordinates at all3 horizons by exactly0 in both training and evaluation; raw equivalent is train action mean, not physical zero or hold; keep all other inputs, masks, model parameters and targets unchanged
arms.task_embedding: unchanged one-task closed-set lookup; no new-task language claim
arms.persistence_reference: last observed visual latent repeated, normalized state residual0 on exactly matching target support
arms.random_reference: fresh paired initialization before learning for each seed and arm, no checkpoint selection

future_execution_design.training_entrypoint_status: not_implemented_for_multiepisode_study; old fixed-pair runner must not be repurposed by removing its guards
future_execution_design.sampling: separate CPU torch.Generator per seed; uniform verified training group, then uniform episode within group, then uniform complete window; identical draws shared by both arms
future_execution_design.normalization_and_sampler_hashes: must be materialized and frozen after accepted source/feature pack and before any optimization
future_execution_design.zero_arm_gradient_expectation: action_projection.weight may have exactlyzero gradient when its input is zero; all graph-connected parameter gradients must exist and be finite; global norm must be nonzero; do not require each tensor to be nonzero
future_execution_design.checkpoint: only final200 per arm/seed; same safe save/reload checks, no best-validation selection

evaluation.primary: per-validation-episode normalized8D state MAE, paired observed_action minus normalized_zero_action; macro mean over episodes then mean and descriptive std over3 seeds
evaluation.imbalance: group-balanced train sampling and episode-macro primary reporting; retain windows/valid scalar counts and micro metrics; no implicit truncation of longer episodes
evaluation.comparisons: both arms versus persistence and per-seed random; report absolute/relative changes, zero denominator -> null
evaluation.fairness: identical initial parameter bytes within each seed, targets, features, train normalization, draws, optimizer settings and step count; only candidate action values differ; action0 also applied during evaluation
evaluation.efficiency: training/evaluation/checkpoint wall time separately per arm/seed, same runtime; no broad cross-model speed claim
evaluation.independent_unit: source episode/group, not overlapping windows or episode-by-seed replicates
evaluation.uncertainty: four holdout episodes and3 optimizer seeds give descriptive consistency only; seeds do not create new data; no significance claim
evaluation.decision: state learning beyond history is supported only descriptively if episode-macro observed-minus-zero MAE is negative for all3 seeds and observed arm beats persistence; report every episode/seed and any visual regression. Mixed signs, failure to beat persistence, or cross-split provenance failure -> inconclusive/no benefit as appropriate; no automatic tuning
evaluation.robustness: not tested in this clean-only study; clean/degraded paired feature protocol is separate future work
evaluation.history_ablation: not part of current two-arm budget; required separately before claiming history module contribution
evaluation.causality: offline observed-action predictive association only; no counterfactual ground truth, candidate ranking or causal control-effect claim
